async def act(page):
    # Click the first 'Epoch & Drift Benchmark' link to navigate to the homepage
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Epoch & Drift Benchmark").first.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Locate the search bar using accessibility roles
    search_bar = page.get_by_role("searchbox")
    if await search_bar.count() == 0:
        search_bar = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Search")
    if await search_bar.count() == 0:
        search_bar = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="search")
    if await search_bar.count() == 0:
        search_bar = page.get_by_role("textbox").first
    
    # Fill the search bar with 'Collector' and submit the search
    await search_bar.fill("Collector")
    await search_bar.press("Enter")
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Click the first result (assumed to be a link)
    first_result = page.get_by_role("link").first
    await first_result.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
